classification.difficultyReason: Update probabilities without replacement, multiply along paths, and combine ordered events using addition or a complement.

inlines.text: A bag contains 5 blue (B) and 3 white (W) marbles.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Complete the tree diagram by writing the probabilities on the branches and the probability of each event.

spec.description: Two-stage tree with B above W at each stage. Ordered-event labels align with the four terminal branches. Space above and below branches and to the right of each event is reserved for handwritten probabilities and calculations.
spec.mathematics: First draw B or W; second draw B or W without replacement. Ordered outcomes BB, BW, WB, WW.
spec.answerVisibility: Branches, colour labels and ordered-event labels are permanent. All probabilities and calculations are withheld.

answer.short: First branches: $\frac58,\frac38$. After B: $\frac47,\frac37$. After W: $\frac57,\frac27$. Events BB, BW, WB, WW: $\frac5{14},\frac{15}{56},\frac{15}{56},\frac3{28}$.
answer.worked:
There are 7 marbles remaining for the second draw. Multiply along each path:
$$\begin{aligned}P(BB)&=\frac58\times\frac47=\frac{20}{56}=\frac5{14}\\P(BW)&=\frac58\times\frac37=\frac{15}{56}\\P(WB)&=\frac38\times\frac57=\frac{15}{56}\\P(WW)&=\frac38\times\frac27=\frac6{56}=\frac3{28}.\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Completed tree with six branch probabilities and four event calculations aligned to their paths.
spec.mathematics: Branch probabilities are 5/8, 3/8; 4/7, 3/7 after B; 5/7, 2/7 after W.

children.prompt: A blue and a white in that order
